env_source.note: Verbatim snapshot of the environment the LLM is asked to write a reward for. Committed rather than read live from $MANISKILL_REPO so an old run's prompt is re-derivable after the pod that produced it is gone, and so a prompt change shows up in git diff. t3/assemble.py re-hashes the installed copy against this and refuses to build a prompt if they differ.
